name: Be Not Afraid: Threads Of Light
source:
Play through the first story of The Hand Of God - and God's Loving Heart. Two divine beings. Also, a literal hand and heart. When heaven demands overtime, extra hours in the office - They begin to question what a life outside divine duty might just look like.

As they work endless cases, take strange prayer calls, and face emotional overloads on Heaven's prayer request line, something begins to grow between them. Soft.. terrifying. It may just be love, even though neither of them was designed to survive it.

Be not afraid.

Even light learns how to love.

[From [url=https://ihammedia.itch.io/threads-of-light]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
畅玩《上帝之手 - 和上帝慈爱之心》的第一个故事。两个神灵。此外，还有真正的手和心。当天堂要求加班、在办公室加班时——他们开始质疑神圣职责之外的生活会是什么样子。

当他们处理无数的案件，接到奇怪的祈祷电话，并在天堂的祈祷热线中面对情感超负荷时，他们之间开始产生一些分歧。软软的..可怕。这可能只是爱情，尽管他们都不是为了生存而生的。

不要害怕。

连光也学会了如何去爱。

[来自[url=https://ihammedia.itch.io/threads-of-light]Itch.io[/url]]
